items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: I didn't know nothing about him, but I could hear people talking about second Kid Punch... everybody said Kid Punch and then Fell Dave.

ctx.x: He was a righty trumpet player.

Yeah, see, that was he was. There's fellas out there, boy. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Uh, there's none of this four years. Tell me he dropped data at Ramp-Ardon, Cornell. Ramp-Ardon, Tulane. He was going in the name of second Kid Punch, see. Uh-huh. I didn't know nothing about him. But I could hear people talking about second Kid Punch. Well, I was at Milling Bird one day playing on a Sunday. Uh-huh. He was going in the name of second Kid Punch, see. I didn't know nothing about him, but I could hear people talking…
Well who was the uh... I don't know what his name was, nothing. Who was the other you know kind of straight trumpet man and straight reading guys, couldn't get off much?
